verdict.sentence: Clear water, 60°F water, calm Saturday morning.

level.note: No gauge on this lake. From the shoreline: steady since over 2 weeks ago.

clarity.label: Clear water
clarity.note: Last clear view: about a week ago.

ice.caveat: Ice thickness is an estimate from air temperature, not a measurement. Check the ice yourself before going on it.

days.summary: Best bite 8:00 am to 8:45 am (sunrise). Also good 1:15 pm to 2:00 pm.
Best bite 3:30 pm to 4:45 pm (sunset and moon underfoot).

fishing.note: Based on sun and moon times and the wind forecast. A guide, not a promise.

later.summary: Best bite 3:30 pm to 5:45 pm (sunset and moon underfoot). Also good 6:30 am to 8:45 am.
Best bite 4:15 pm to 5:45 pm (sunset and moon underfoot). Also good 6:30 am to 8:45 am.
Best bite 5:30 am to 8:45 am (moon overhead and sunrise). Also good 3:30 pm to 6:45 pm.
Best bite 6:30 am to 7:45 am (sunrise and moon overhead). Also good 3:30 pm to 5:45 pm.
Best bite 6:45 am to 8:30 am (sunrise and moon overhead). Also good 3:30 pm to 5:45 pm.
